items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: They had a chance to go down to Kelly's Stables, and so he asked me did I want to go down to Kelly's Stables with them, and I said, 'Yeah, I'll go down there.'

ctx.x: How was it that you joined up with him, that you met up with him and started playing?

Well, I used to work around different places, club dates and... I would mostly get a lot of work from the Rhythm Club. All the musicians would hang out around the Rhythm Club. John Kirby...not John Kirby... At Johnson used to get work from the Rhythm Club. He had a trio, a set(?) with At Johnson and a piano player. They had a chance to go down to Kelly's Stables, and so he asked me did I want to go down to Kelly's Stables with them, and I said, 'Yeah, I'll go down there.' I think the (?) was paying around forty…
Was this immediately after you left Kirby? Or was this after Kirby, and you'd gone back to the Victoria?
